scope: Simulation-only navigation and downstream command expiry; C++ mission authorization unchanged
historical_worlds: Phase3.1 worlds-v3 seeds 41,42,43: diagnosis/reproduction only; never configuration selection

development.selection: Development completion, independent arrival and clearance; select the smallest successful correction. Navigation deadline remains 30 s.

held_out.generation: After corrected configuration/source freeze, use a fresh SystemRandom seed; persist seed, input generator hash and all generated assets before execution
held_out.authority_and_actuator: Identical unchanged mission validator and identical downstream expiry in both paired variants
held_out.ordering: Randomized paired world order, balanced variant-first assignment; fresh simulator per world/variant
held_out.failure_policy: Abort subsequent mission dispatch after a fault; retain failed and unattempted requests; no automatic retry or replacement

acceptance.comparison: Report all planned completion denominators, paired world outcomes, travel time/path length on observed missions, localization error and missingness; no tuning after held-out execution

expiry.precondition: Independent ground-truth translation >0.05 m/s and a nonzero applied command before injection

acceptance.process_stall: On resumption, expiry latches zero before sustained movement resumes; physical Windows/WSL host suspension is not inferred from this proxy

expiry.residuals: Trusted local ROS/Gazebo transports; no certified safety hardware or physical stopping verification

preparation.clock_handshake: At most three read-only preparations per mission; every accepted reply must satisfy unchanged receiver_clock one-second RTT bound. Record every attempt. No rejected/failed mission is retried or replaced.
preparation.idle_callbacks: Shared executor drains ROS callbacks while polling Windows spool at 10 Hz; all TF/scan freshness checks and mission deadlines unchanged.
